mechanism_claims.claim_text: NOSO-502 is reported as an odilorhabdin-class inhibitor of bacterial translation/ribosomal decoding, but this paper uses that mechanism as class context rather than presenting new direct ribosome-binding assays.
mechanism_claims.limitations: Do not promote to direct_mechanism from this paper alone; mechanism statement is source-located in abstract/introduction/discussion and cites prior odilorhabdin work.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: NOSO-502 retained activity against many colistin-resistance mechanisms but crrB mutations were an exception in Table 4, consistent with paper discussion of LPS modification and RND efflux in crrAB-mediated resistance.
mechanism_claims.entity_scope: colistin-resistant Escherichia coli and Klebsiella pneumoniae panels
mechanism_claims.limitations: This is resistance-phenotype context, not a direct NOSO-502 target assay.

source_locator.locator: xml:table=4; xml:sec=2:NOSO-502 exhibits potent antibacterial activity.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: NOSO-502 showed low spontaneous resistance frequencies in E. coli ATCC 25922 and K. pneumoniae ATCC 43816 at 4x/8x MIC.
mechanism_claims.limitations: Phenotypic frequency result; does not identify a new molecular resistance mechanism.
